annotations.title: utilpeek: generate UUIDs (v4, v7) or ULIDs

description: utilpeek: Generate UUIDs or ULIDs. For numbers, bytes and picks use generate_random. Returns 1-100 new identifiers: random UUID v4, time-ordered UUID v7 (RFC 9562) or ULIDs, optionally strictly increasing within the response (v7 and ULID; per response on purpose, so one caller cannot predict another's next ID). Input: optional `kind`, `version`, `count` and `monotonic`; an empty body gives one UUID v4. `version` with kind=ulid, or `monotonic` with v4, is a 422 (not charged). Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/uuid-generator-api.html

monotonic.description: v7 / ULID only: strictly increasing within this response.
monotonic.title: Monotonic

version.description: UUID version 4 (random, default) or 7 (time-ordered); kind=uuid only.
